note: Hand-written 2026-11-14. Typical steps a county takes to start a project, in plain language. General practice, not legal advice: every plan carries a caveat to confirm the process with the county attorney and the funding agency. No step cites a statute. document_ids refer to data/project_documents.json.

default.title: Brief the county board or commission
default.detail: Share the need, the proposed project and the funding leads, and ask for direction to proceed.

default.title: Name a project lead and partners
default.detail: One staff lead, plus the agencies, utilities, nonprofits or owners the project depends on.

default.title: Hold a public meeting or listening session
default.detail: Hear from the residents the project is meant to help before plans are fixed.

default.title: Confirm who owns the site and whether they are willing
default.detail: Check the assessor's records, then contact the owner about access and a longer-term agreement.

default.title: Visit the site and record its condition
default.detail: Photos, access, utilities nearby, and anything the aerial view could not show.

default.title: Choose the funding leads to pursue and note their deadlines
default.detail: Confirm each program's status and eligibility with the agency before relying on it.

default.title: Draft a budget and cost-share plan
default.detail: Include any local match the programs require and who would pay it.

default.title: Adopt a board resolution authorizing the project and applications
default.detail: A draft is in the document pack; the county attorney should review it.

default.title: Ask planning and zoning which permits apply
default.detail: Land use, building and any state permits for this kind of project.

default.title: Ask each funding agency whether an environmental review is required
default.detail: Federal funds often come with one; starting early avoids delays.

default.title: Prepare a request for proposals under county procurement rules
default.detail: Define the scope, the evaluation criteria and the timeline.

default.title: Set milestones and how results will be reported
default.detail: Report back to the board and the public on progress and outcomes.

community_solar.title: Check the site's cleanup status with the state environmental agency
community_solar.detail: Reclaimed land may have use limits or monitoring that shape where panels can go.

community_solar.title: Request an interconnection review from the utility
Check elective-pay eligibility for the clean electricity credits
community_solar.detail: Note the in-service deadlines for solar.

resilience_hub.title: Request an interconnection review from the utility
Check elective-pay eligibility for the clean electricity credits
Agree the hub's role with the emergency management office
resilience_hub.detail: When it opens, who staffs it, and what it must power during an outage.

landfill_gas_energy.title: Confirm gas rights and data with the landfill owner and operator

landfill_composting.title: Agree land use and operations with the landfill owner and operator
Ask the state solid-waste agency what permit a composting site needs
Line up food-scrap sources: schools, groceries, haulers

flood_buyout.title: List repeatedly flooded properties with the floodplain manager
Confirm the county's hazard mitigation plan is current
flood_buyout.detail: FEMA mitigation grants generally require one; ask the State Hazard Mitigation Officer.

flood_buyout.title: Make voluntary offers to willing owners only

wildfire_defensible_space.title: Coordinate with the state forestry agency and local fire districts

public_ev_charging.title: Ask the utility about service upgrades for the chargers

weatherization_clinic.title: Partner with the local weatherization or energy-assistance agency

utility_assistance_drive.title: Partner with the local energy-assistance agency to staff sign-ups

heat_pump_group_buy.title: Invite local installers to quote a group price

mobile_home_repair.title: Partner with the local weatherization agency and housing nonprofits

water_system_consolidation.title: Meet the state drinking water program about consolidation help

drinking_water_compliance.title: Meet the state drinking water program about the systems with violations

microtransit.title: Ask the state DOT transit office about rural transit funding

mobility_hub.title: Ask the state DOT about active-transportation funding

lead_note: lead_days: how many days before the target grant's deadline a step should be done. Our own planning assumptions for a small county, not program rules; null means after award.
